Enid is tall with a thin waist, big fat tits and child bearing hip and extremely thick thighs. She has light brown skin and thick, waist length purple hair tied in a small spiky bun. She has big eyes, a small rectangle shaped nose, and thin lips. She typically wears a sleeveless blue Gar's Bodega uniform crop top that is torn at the bottom to expose her midriff, black compression shorts, and brown boots, along with white cloth wrappings on the upper half of her arms.

Enid is the most responsible of the main trio even though she is lazy. She tries to use logic and critical thinking to make rational decisions.

Enid can turn into a were-bunny after being bit by Crinkly Wrinkly. She became a bunny because, according to herself, she's quick on her feet. In this form, Enid obtains bunny-like abilities and particularities, like digging tunnels underground and eating carrots. Her strength and speed are theorized to increase as well. She gain heightened hearing, speed, reaction time, Two large bunny ears, A bunny tail, And her skin gain a light purple fur coating. She also gain the instincts of a bunny and become extremely horny when she transform.

In her earlier teen years, she went through a dorky phase. In middle school, she wore a large blue and periwinkle jacket with black shorts and brown sandals, and she wore her hair loose (sometimes in a ponytail) with a blue headband tied around her head. Her other early teen appearances show her with acne and braces, one appearance had her with braided pigtails, another had her with her hair in a wavy low ponytail with sunglasses and a tie-dye t-shirt.

Enid temporarily becomes a mime. As a mime, Enid's appearance changes to the classic mime outfit: she wears a black beret, white face paint with exaggerated features, a striped black-and-white shirt, black pants, and gloves.

Due to her ninja training and her days working alongside Rad and Mr. Gar, Enid is strong enough to fight even stronger people than her. Enid has excellent combat skills. Her fighting style seems to focus more on kicks and strategy, rather than strength, which goes with her epithet of ninja. She has a great agility and is very flexible, able to move quickly and with precision.

Body Replacement Technique: Enid can disappear at will, leaving behind a puff of smoke and a log when she does.
Smokescreen: where she can make a smoke screen to confuse her opponents.
Cloning: She can create immobile clones of herself that turn into wood when touched.
Tornado Finger: to make a tornado by using a finger technique. To create it, she realizes a quick move with her fingers.
Shadow Spirit: she summoned a giant humanoid shadowy spirit with red eyes, that could form a sword with its arm which also branched out into smaller spines on it.
Fire Generation: Enid was able to produce a ring of fire around her through intense concentration before a tidal wave extinguished it.
Ice Breath: Enid is shown to have ice breath from her cold heart.
Shapeshifting:Enid can transform into a log, in the same shape of her decoy log. It can be shot out of a cannon, and she can transform back with ease.
